name: label
description: An accessible form label that associates with its control
designIntent: Label names a form control so screen readers announce the field name together with its value and state. Use htmlFor to associate, or wrap the control.

props.name: htmlFor
props.description: The id of the control this label describes

antiPatterns.title: Don't use placeholder as a label
antiPatterns.explanation: Placeholders disappear on input and are skipped by many screen readers.

accessibility.implementation: htmlFor/id pairing links the label to its control
accessibility.userRequirements: Ensure the id matches the control exactly

guidelines: Describe the field, not the action

compositionRules.relationship: Every input should have a label
